_comment: Epic #5861 L6: SYNTHETIC representative profiles for scripts/sample_weeks_5861.py and tests/test_acceptance_5861.py. No personal data: every number is invented for the scenario (a round synthetic body mass in lb only so the load floor has a weigh-in to read; generated loads are synthetic). Each profile names what its synthetic Hevy record shows; the generator turns it into workouts over the prior phase.

a_large_deficit_experienced.label: (a) large deficit, experienced, 5 mornings, 75-min cap, high daily steps
a_large_deficit_experienced.story: every lift progressing on double progression; green readiness, normal sleep; walks most of the day

b_shoulder_flag_low_recovery.label: (b) as (a) + a shoulder pain flag + a low-recovery week
b_shoulder_flag_low_recovery.story: a pain-class note on the overhead press and on the dip; red readiness and short sleep this week

pain.note: sharp shoulder pain 6/10 on the press

c_equipment_limited.label: (c) equipment-limited: no selectorized/plate machines, no cable stack
c_equipment_limited.story: a garage-style setup: barbell, rack, benches, dumbbells, kettlebells, bands, a pull-up bar, a treadmill and an upright bike

d_stalled_anchor_adherence_dip.label: (d) a stalled anchor + an adherence dip
d_stalled_anchor_adherence_dip.story: the bench and an accessory flat for three exposures at RPE 8-9; only 5 of the last 14 days' planned sessions done

e_short_week.label: (e) a 4-day short week
e_short_week.story: travel takes Friday: four sessions this week

f_high_fatigue_poor_sleep.label: (f) high fatigue / poor sleep
f_high_fatigue_poor_sleep.story: short nights, red readiness, a lot of hard cardio, compounds regressing, discomfort notes on the deadlift

discomfort.note: lower back a bit achy and tight today
